## Checklist

- [ ] I used only fictional or safely redacted information.
- [ ] I kept this change focused.
- [ ] I added or updated tests in proportion to risk.
- [ ] I did not weaken a safeguard for convenience or demonstration purposes.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation and threat assumptions.
- [ ] I reviewed keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, contrast, and reduced-motion
